command: for n in /sys/class/drm/card*-*; do [ -d "$n" ] || continue; printf '\nCONNECTOR %s\n' "$n"; for f in status enabled modes; do if [ -r "$n/$f" ]; then printf '%s: ' "$f"; cat "$n/$f"; fi; done; if [ -r "$n/edid" ]; then printf 'edid_bytes: '; wc -c < "$n/edid"; fi; done; ls -l /dev/dri 2>/dev/null || true; for c in modetest kmsprint weston gst-launch-1.0 v4l2-ctl ffmpeg; do command -v "$c" || true; done; ps -eo pid,comm,args | grep -Ei 'weston|Xorg|wayland|qmmf|camera' | grep -v grep || true; loginctl list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null || true
